benchmarkPanel.panelDescription: Move the chute from one bin to another while closing one layer's gate and opening another's, timed as one operation.
benchmarkPanel.closeGateInfo: Which layer's gate closes during the timed move.
benchmarkPanel.openGateInfo: Which layer's gate opens during the timed move.
benchmarkPanel.randomDescription: Drives to random bins in random layers, one after another, timing each move and reporting the spread.

errors.loadLayout: Failed to load the bin layout.
errors.chuteTimeout: Timed out waiting for the chute to stop.
errors.sameLayer: Pick two different layers to close and open — the same gate can't be measured opening and closing at once.
